QUIC packet and frame pretty-printing to JSON-like text, with header parsing and frame decoding.

# Purpose
This C file implements pretty-print support for QUIC packets and QUIC frames. It decodes packet headers, identifies the packet type, and writes a JSON-like text representation into an output buffer. The main entry point, [`fd_quic_pretty_print_quic_pkt`](<#fd_quic_pretty_print_quic_pkt>), formats packet metadata such as flow direction, connection index, time, and IP and UDP addresses, then calls header and frame printers to describe the packet contents.

The file also contains frame-specific decode and print logic for several QUIC frame types, including padding and ping, ACK frames, crypto frames, stream frames, and connection close frames. It uses generated decode and print functions from the `templ/` headers, and it handles variable-length fields and repeated substructures such as ACK ranges and stream payload data. The functions [`fd_quic_pretty_print_quic_hdr_initial`](<#fd_quic_pretty_print_quic_hdr_initial>), [`fd_quic_pretty_print_quic_hdr_handshake`](<#fd_quic_pretty_print_quic_hdr_handshake>), [`fd_quic_pretty_print_quic_hdr_one_rtt`](<#fd_quic_pretty_print_quic_hdr_one_rtt>), [`fd_quic_pretty_print_quic_hdr`](<#fd_quic_pretty_print_quic_hdr>), and [`fd_quic_pretty_print_frames`](<#fd_quic_pretty_print_frames>) form the public interface for packet and frame tracing.
